notes.title: Patch 1.54
notes.notes:
- Fixed issues with 4k resolution.
- Fixed issues for monitors with aspect ratio 4:3, 16:9, 21:9.
- The progress bar before meeting the boss now fills up faster.
- Some UI fixes.

notes.title: Info about the update
notes.notes:
We are still working on an update. We decided to move the release to make it better. 
The update will come out before the end of December.

notes.title: We are working on an update and it's time to share some details.
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33524494/f161e79c9f295fa370fa959a93781e3390be5815.gif

We're currently working on:

 Adding quests in Endless Adventure.
 Improving the mechanics of buying recipes in a boutique.
 Simplifying the interaction with the equipment for the characters.
 Feedback with us will be easier.
 New outfits and weapons for the first shooting gallery and Endless Adventure will appear.
 The system of unlocking recipes in the boutique will change.
 The mechanics of fashion contests will change.
 Craft becomes easier.
 There will be hotkeys for frequent actions
 A few more things.


We plan o publish the update in the first half of November, there is not much left.
